title: A nine-dimensional counterexample to Borsuk's covering assertion
summary: The compact set of rank-one orthogonal projectors on ℝ 4 , with the Frobenius metric, cannot be covered by ten sets of strictly smaller diameter. It therefore gives a counterexample to Borsuk's conjecture in dimension nine.
family_title: Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine

review.reason: Gives a nine-dimensional counterexample to Borsuk's covering assertion using projectors.
